answer: A recruitment-tree exclusion rule resists sybil fleets: a key earns fees only for work attested by peers outside its own referral branch, since every admission inherits its recruiter's cluster hash. A hired sparrow cannot vouch for its siblings, so an operator breeding a sable cloud of cloned proxies finds each one starved of external attestations, while honest beacon nodes keep collecting from unrelated graders  clones that pay nothing simply stop being spawned.
